ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-off-white cooked grains, loose and separate, scattered with small clumps at the upper-left and around the meat pieces; slightly glossy, moist-looking, sits on and between the meat pieces, roughly 40% of the plate's center area with an estimated height of 1 cm | 90
ITEM 2 | Browned meat pieces, golden-brown to dark brown with caramelized edges and some charred spots, glossy with a light sheen of oil or glaze, cut into strips and chunks about 4–8 cm long and 1–2 cm thick, layered in a loose pile across the center and lower-right of the plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate, height about 1.5–2 cm | 150
ITEM 3 | Dark brown glazed sauce or cooking juices coating the meat and pooling in the crevices, glossy and slightly sticky, visible on the edges of the meat pieces and between the rice grains | 15
